description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: apikey

Dynamic wizard for generating computed instalment plan definitions. Returns different 
types based on computation results (programmatic, choice, fixedAmounts, percentageAmounts, null).

Each definition expects different `formData`, so there is no single fixed request schema —
send the fields that definition requires. Compute is iterative: call it repeatedly, feeding
each result forward, until it returns a final state. Then pass the `id` from that last
compute response to create_instalment_plan.
